title: Evaluating an Iterated Double Integral over a Rectangle
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Evaluate the double integral iint_R (4 - x - y) dA over R = [0, 2] x [0, 1].

steps.title: Set Up Iterated Integral with Respect to y First
steps.explanation: Integrate inner variable y from 0 to 1 holding x constant.

steps.title: Evaluate Inner Integral with Respect to y
steps.explanation: Compute antiderivative with respect to y and plug in limits 0 and 1.

steps.title: Evaluate Outer Integral with Respect to x
steps.explanation: Integrate the resulting function of x over [0, 2].
